assessments.summary: Measles cases in the US are peaking with a 229% increase in weekly reports over the past 8 months, reaching 229 cases per week in the latest week.
Dengue cases in the US are peaking with an 853% increase in weekly reports over the past 8 months, reaching 83 cases per week in the latest week.
Mpox cases in the US are peaking with an 87% increase in weekly reports over the past 8 months, reaching 52 cases per week in the latest week.
Global flu test positivity is peaking at 11.7% for the week of 2026-11-02, up 27% from the previous month.
Polio Wikipedia readership is peaking at the 98th percentile of the past year, indicating heightened public interest.
West Nile virus cases in the US are peaking with a 1388% increase in weekly reports over the past 8 months, reaching 115 cases per week in the latest week.
Global RSV test positivity is at 1.5% for the week of 2026-11-02, down 6% from the previous month, while US hospital admissions are rising.
Chikungunya cases in the US are at baseline with a 30% increase in weekly reports over the past 8 months, but Switzerland reported its first locally acquired cases this year.
Legionnaires' disease cases in the US are rising, with a 45% increase in the 8-week average compared to the previous 8 months.
US COVID-19 hospital admissions are slightly rising, with 5,025 admissions reported for the week of 2026-11-14, up 13% from the previous month.
US reported whooping cough cases are rising, with a 55% increase in the 8-week average compared to the previous 8 months.
US malaria cases are rising, with a 30% increase in the 8-week average compared to the previous 8 months.
Wikipedia readership for human metapneumovirus is at the 36th percentile of the past year.
US hepatitis A cases are slightly rising, with a 10% increase in the 8-week average compared to the previous 8 months.
Wikipedia readership for norovirus is at the 36th percentile of the past year.
